results.title: The 6th International Conference of TESOL & Education – International Association of TESOL & Education
results.content: # The 6th International Conference of TESOL & Education. Greetings from the Organizing Committee of the 6th International Conference on TESOL & Education (ICTE 2026)! Early registration ensures your place at the conference and is a prerequisite for paper publication. In response to the strong international interest in the conference, and in order to create a more convenient schedule for our **keynote speakers, featured speakers, and presenters**, the Organizing Committee would like to announce an adjustment to the conference dates. By presenting at the conference, authors may be considered for publication in reputable outlets, including **CALL-EJ (Scopus Q1)**, **rEFLections (Scopus Q2)**, **Springer Nature book chapters (Scopus Q4) (****extended to 30 March)**, and **ICTE Press publications** such as the *International Journal of TESOL and Education*, the *International Journal of Language Instruction*, or the *ICTE Conference Proceedings*. * and ICTE Press publications such as the **International Journal of TESOL and Education**, the **International Journal of Language Instruction**, or the **ICTE Conference Proceedings**.
